# Assets — Goal Party

Every file in `public/` with its source and license. Kit assets (fonts, shared sounds) are listed in
`packages/kit/ASSETS.md`. The footballer, ball, icons and effects are drawn in code.

| File | Source | Author / provider | License | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `public/icon.svg` | Drawn by hand for this repo | Gaze Arena contributors | CC0-1.0 | PWA icon |

## Pending (declared in `assets.yaml`, generated by a human with `npm run assets`)
- `public/assets/img/stadium-night.webp` — until it exists the scene draws its code fallback background.
- `public/assets/audio/<locale>/chant-goal.mp3` — until it exists the kit's `chant-generic.wav` plays.
